summary.business_type: Freelance web developer / IT service provider (hybrid: portfolio + local service-area business targeting Debrecen & Hajdú-Bihar)
data_limitations: PageSpeed Insights API daily quota exhausted - performance scored from lab proxies (JS weight, TTFB, resource audit), not Lighthouse/CrUX.
No Google Search Console / GA4 credentials configured - no indexation or traffic data.
No backlink API credentials - backlink profile not assessed.
top_findings: Blog post 'Offline-First ... 10 000+ felhasználó' (and the EN projects copy) claims a 10,000+ user app that the uncommitted change removes from the portfolio - unverifiable experience claims hurt E-E-A-T
Thin service pages: /hu/online-hirdetes (~200 words) and /hu/it-uzemeltetes (~210 words incl. nav/footer) target commercial keywords with almost no unique content
No trust proof anywhere: no testimonials, reviews, client logos, case-study numbers, phone number or photo of you
Local targeting (Debrecen) without local signals: ProfessionalService schema has no address/telephone/geo, no Google Business Profile link
Blog topics (developer case studies) do not match the buyer audience (small businesses) and blog posts never link to the service pages
quick_wins: Shorten 3 blog <title>s (79-100 chars) to under 60 chars
Add contextual links from each blog post to /hu/weboldal-keszites and /hu/webshop-keszites
Add telephone, address/areaServed Debrecen, priceRange and a real headshot to Person/ProfessionalService JSON-LD
Remove the site-wide identical <meta name=keywords> (ignored by Google, leaks keyword strategy)
Remove the duplicate 'index, follow' robots meta on the 404 page

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Server-side rendered (Next.js prerender) - full content present without JavaScript
Self-referencing canonicals on all 14 pages; reciprocal hreflang hu-HU/en-US/x-default on bilingual pages
robots.txt allows crawling, blocks /api/, references sitemap
XML sitemap with 14 URLs and xhtml:link alternates
HTTPS + HSTS (2 years); apex and http redirect to https://www
Unknown URLs return a real 404 with noindex; preview domain csukaviktor.vercel.app/hu returns 404 noindex (no duplicate)
Edge-cached HTML, TTFB ~115 ms warm

findings.title: 404 page emits two conflicting robots meta tags
findings.description: /hu/nonexistent-xyz returns 404 with both <meta name=robots content=noindex> and <meta name=robots content='index, follow'> (layout metadata in src/app/[lang]/layout.tsx:149 is not overridden by not-found).
findings.recommendation: Export metadata { robots: { index: false } } from src/app/[lang]/not-found.tsx so only one tag is emitted.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod is the build timestamp for all static pages
findings.description: Homepages and all 4 service pages share lastmod 2026-10-18T21:48:40Z, i.e. new Date() at build. Google ignores lastmod that is not consistently accurate.
findings.recommendation: Use a real per-page content date (hard-coded or from git) instead of build time.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only Strict-Transport-Security is sent. No Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy or X-Frame-Options.
findings.recommendation: Add headers() in next.config.ts with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, X-Frame-Options: DENY (or frame-ancestors), Permissions-Policy.

findings.title: Apex domain takes two redirect hops
findings.description: https://csukaviktor.com -> 301 https://www.csukaviktor.com/ -> 308 /hu. Acceptable, but each hop costs latency for links pointing at the apex.
findings.recommendation: Optional: point the apex redirect directly to https://www.csukaviktor.com/hu in Vercel domain settings.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Service pages have clear pricing (19 999 Ft-tól, 49 999 Ft-tól, 9 999 Ft/hó) and FAQ sections - strong intent match
/hu/weboldal-keszites (~460 words) has a good structure: what's included, pricing, process, local section, FAQ
One real, verifiable reference project (hoodini.hu webshop)

findings.title: Unverifiable experience claims in blog and EN copy
findings.description: The uncommitted change in src/lib/translations.ts removes the 'Mobile Companion App - 10 000+ active users' and 'SaaS Dashboard' projects from the HU portfolio, but the blog still publishes 'Offline-First architektúra React Native alkalmazásban: 10 000+ felhasználó tanulságai' (src/lib/blog.ts:165-219) and 'Valós idejű Task Manager SaaS' and the EN projects copy still says '10,000+ active users' (translations.ts:233). Experience claims with no matching project are a trust/E-E-A-T risk with both readers and Google's quality raters.
findings.recommendation: Either back these posts with a real project (link, screenshots, repo) or rewrite/remove them. Sync the EN translations with the HU removal.

findings.title: Thin commercial service pages
findings.description: /hu/online-hirdetes ~198 words and /hu/it-uzemeltetes ~209 words total, of which ~150 are shared nav/footer/contact boilerplate. /hu/webshop-keszites ~355. These pages target competitive commercial keywords (Google Ads kezelés, weboldal üzemeltetés) where ranking pages typically have 800-1500 words.
findings.recommendation: Expand each to 700+ words of unique content: who it is for, what is included in each price tier, process, a mini case study, 5-8 FAQs, local section (Debrecen).

findings.title: No social proof or trust signals
findings.description: No testimonials, Google reviews, client logos, measurable results, years of experience, phone number or photo. For a local service provider these are the main conversion and E-E-A-T signals.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-4 client testimonials with names/company, a hoodini.hu case study with numbers, a real headshot, and an 'About' block with experience and credentials.

findings.title: Blog targets developers, not buyers; blog is stale
findings.description: 3 posts, newest 2026-02-10 (8+ months), all developer case studies (Next.js 14, Supabase, React Native) at ~300 words. The site sells websites to small businesses; none of the posts answer buyer questions. 'Next.js 14' is also dated (site runs Next 16).
findings.recommendation: Publish buyer-intent articles: 'Mennyibe kerül egy weboldal 2026-ban?', 'Weboldal vs. Facebook oldal kisvállalkozásnak', 'Google Cégprofil beállítása lépésről lépésre', 'Webshop indítás: Shopify vs egyedi'. Link each to the matching service page.

findings.title: Mixed positioning: job-seeker vs service provider
findings.description: The header CTA 'Felveszel?' (hire me as an employee) and portfolio framing sit next to 'kkv-knak' agency-style service offers and a 'we' voice in schema/service copy ('Informatikai szolgáltatásunk'). Mixed signals dilute the topical focus and confuse visitors.
findings.recommendation: Decide the primary audience. If clients: change CTA to 'Kérj ajánlatot', use consistent first-person singular voice, move job-seeking to a secondary /rolam section.

findings.title: Projects section contains a tutorial-style clone
findings.description: 'Spotify Clone' is one of three showcased projects. Clones read as learning projects to business buyers.
findings.recommendation: Replace with client work or a business-relevant demo (e.g. a sample local business site).

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, keyword-led titles and descriptions on all service pages (53-65 chars titles, 145-160 chars descriptions)
Exactly one H1 per page, logical H2/H3 hierarchy
Homepage links to all 4 service pages and the 3 blog posts
Service pages cross-link to each other ('Kapcsolódó szolgáltatások')

findings.title: Blog post titles too long
findings.description: Titles are 79, 84 and 100 characters (e.g. 'Offline-First architektúra React Native alkalmazásban: 10 000+ felhasználó tanulságai | Csuka Viktor'). Google truncates around 60 chars.
findings.recommendation: Use a shorter SEO title (metadata.title) separate from the on-page H1, under 60 chars.

findings.title: Blog posts do not link to service pages
findings.description: Blog posts only link to home, blog index and their language alternate. The Next.js+Stripe post is a natural link source for /hu/webshop-keszites.
findings.recommendation: Add an in-content link and an end-of-post CTA to the relevant service page.

findings.title: Homepage H1 does not contain the main money keyword
findings.description: H1 'Webfejlesztő és IT szolgáltatások kkv-knak.' Search demand is on 'weboldal készítés' (+ Debrecen). The homepage and /hu/weboldal-keszites compete with each other for generic queries.
findings.recommendation: Keep the homepage as the brand/overview page but add 'weboldal készítés' and Debrecen to the homepage title/intro, and make sure the homepage links to /hu/weboldal-keszites with that exact anchor.

findings.title: Identical meta keywords and OG image site-wide
findings.description: Every HU page carries the same 15-keyword <meta name=keywords> (ignored by Google, visible to competitors). Every page shares /og-image.jpg, so social shares of services and posts look identical.
findings.recommendation: Remove meta keywords. Generate per-page OG images (Next.js opengraph-image.tsx).

findings.title: English homepage has no path to services
findings.description: /en links only to the blog; the 4 service pages exist only in Hungarian, so English visitors cannot see offers or prices.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable if the market is Hungary-only. Otherwise add at least an English 'Web development services' page.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD @graph on every page: WebSite, Person, ProfessionalService with stable @ids
Service + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage on service pages; BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList on posts; Blog on index
Person.sameAs links GitHub and LinkedIn; BlogPosting author linked by @id

findings.title: ProfessionalService lacks local business properties
findings.description: Service pages target Debrecen/Hajdú-Bihar, but the ProfessionalService node has only areaServed: Hungary - no address (addressLocality Debrecen), telephone, geo, priceRange or openingHours.
findings.recommendation: Add address (PostalAddress with addressLocality Debrecen, addressRegion Hajdú-Bihar, addressCountry HU - street can be omitted for a service-area business), telephone, priceRange '19 999 Ft - ', and areaServed Debrecen. Add the Google Business Profile URL to sameAs once it exists.

findings.title: Person.image is the OG banner, not a photo
findings.description: Person.image and ProfessionalService.image both point to og-image.jpg, and BlogPosting.image uses the same banner for every post.
findings.recommendation: Use a real headshot for Person.image and per-post images for BlogPosting.

findings.title: Service descriptions use plural 'we' voice
findings.description: OfferCatalog item: 'Informatikai szolgáltatásunk része...' while the site presents one person.
findings.recommendation: Use consistent first-person singular copy.

findings.title: FAQPage will not produce rich results
findings.description: Since 2023 Google shows FAQ rich results only for authoritative government/health sites. The markup is harmless and still helps AI engines parse Q&A.
findings.recommendation: Keep it; just do not expect FAQ snippets in Google.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Static prerendered HTML from Vercel edge (TTFB ~115 ms warm, ~1.1 s cold)
LCP element is text (H1), fonts are self-hosted woff2 with preload
Project images lazy-loaded; Vercel Speed Insights installed for field data

findings.title: Lab/field CWV not measured (PSI quota exhausted)
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights API returned a daily-quota error. Score is an estimate from resource analysis.
findings.recommendation: Check the Vercel Speed Insights dashboard (already installed) for real LCP/INP/CLS, or rerun PSI tomorrow.

findings.title: ~215 KB (brotli) JavaScript on the homepage, incl. particle animation
findings.description: 8+ JS chunks totalling ~215 KB compressed; largest 71 KB. @tsparticles runs a canvas animation behind the hero, which costs main-thread time on low-end phones (INP/TBT risk).
findings.recommendation: Load the particles component with next/dynamic { ssr: false } after idle, and skip it on mobile/prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.title: Google Ads gtag preloaded with high priority
findings.description: <link rel=preload as=script href=googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=AW-...> competes with critical resources during initial load.
findings.recommendation: Load via next/script strategy='afterInteractive' or 'lazyOnload' without a preload.

findings.title: Project screenshots generated live by a third-party API
findings.description: Three project images are fetched from api.microlink.io at view time (live screenshot rendering) with no width/height attributes - slow, uncacheable by you, and dependent on an external service.
findings.recommendation: Save the screenshots as local WebP/AVIF and render with next/image (explicit dimensions).

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All content in server HTML - AI crawlers and agents read it without JS
robots.txt allows all agents; AI user agents get identical responses
Clear Q&A blocks and pricing on service pages are easy to quote

findings.title: Little citable, entity-defining content
findings.description: AI answers for 'weboldal készítés Debrecen' cite pages with concrete facts (prices, timelines, process, reviews). The site has prices but no about/credentials page, no reviews and few third-party mentions of 'Csuka Viktor'.
findings.recommendation: Add an About page with a clear entity statement (who, where, since when, what), and get listed on Hungarian directories/review sites to build third-party mentions.

findings.title: No llms.txt or explicit AI crawler policy
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404; robots.txt has no named groups for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended. Not a ranking factor, but cheap to add.
findings.recommendation: Optionally add /llms.txt summarising services and prices with links to the service pages.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 3 content images have descriptive alt text
OG image present (38 KB JPEG)

findings.title: Almost no first-party imagery
findings.description: Service pages have 0 images; there is no photo of you or of finished client work beyond remote screenshots.
findings.recommendation: Add a headshot, before/after or device-mockup screenshots of client sites (local WebP, next/image, descriptive Hungarian alt text).

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Resolve the unverifiable 10,000+ users / SaaS claims: rewrite or remove the two blog posts, sync EN translations with the HU project removal
Change header CTA 'Felveszel?' to 'Kérj ajánlatot' and unify first-person voice
Shorten the 3 blog titles to under 60 chars

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add testimonials, hoodini.hu case study with numbers, headshot and About block
Create a Google Business Profile (service-area, Debrecen) and ask first clients for reviews
Extend ProfessionalService schema: address locality, telephone, priceRange, GBP sameAs
Link every blog post to the relevant service page

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Publish 4 buyer-intent articles (pricing, website vs Facebook, GBP setup, webshop options)
Get listed in Hungarian business directories and local partner sites
Replace microlink screenshots with local images; lazy-load particles; defer gtag
Per-page OG images; remove meta keywords; fix 404 robots duplicate; add security headers

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Search Console and track 'weboldal készítés Debrecen' and the service keywords
Review Vercel Speed Insights CWV monthly
Publish one buyer-intent post per month; refresh pricing yearly
